summary: Progression (chargen, level-up, progression framework) is structurally sound at its core: ProgressionShell/ChargenShell/LevelupShell host step plugins that write to ProgressionSession draft state, and ProgressionFinalizer compiles one validated mutation plan applied transactionally through ActorEngine.applyMutationPlan with rollback evidence. Conformance gaps: (1) runtime monkey-patching persists despite progression-architecture.md stating there is none - five live files reassign TalentStep/ForcePowerStep/FeatStep prototype methods, PrerequisiteChecker/AbilityEngine statics and ProgressionFinalizer statics; (2) ProgressionFinalizer._applyForceKnowledgePostApply exists only because scripts/talents/squad-actions-init.js side-effect-imports a patch file; (3) the chargen Summary step stages system.credits and a store flag on the actor mid-wizard via ActorEngine.updateActor (not TransactionEngine), with duplicated reconciliation in finalizer and economy builder; (4) draft persistence uses raw setFlag in two parallel stores; (5) the legacy static ProgressionEngine stack (~2.6k lines) is loaded by five unused imports and closes an 11-file import cycle through mentor-dialogues.js. 75 census-unreachable modules are mostly dead experiment clusters (ux/, content/, forecast/, talent slot-*).

findings.title: Runtime prototype/static monkey-patches of progression steps and prerequisite authorities
findings.observed: At init, TalentStep (_getTalent, _getTalentDescription, _getTalentBenefit, _getTalentPrerequisiteText, _buildCanonicalTalentSelection, _buildPendingAbilityData, _getOwnedTalentKeys, _getTreeInvestmentCount, onStepEnter, _getAvailableTrees, _getTree, _getTalentsForTree), ForcePowerStep._getTelekineticProdigyResolution, FeatStep (_isFeatSelected, _buildPendingAbilityData, _getLegalFeats), PrerequisiteChecker (5 statics) and AbilityEngine.evaluateAcquisition are wrapped by reassignment. Behavior of these classes depends on registration order; reading the class source does not show actual behavior.
findings.intendedOwnership: Each behavior lives in its owning class or an injected strategy (house-rule grant provider, custom-tree provider) that the class calls explicitly.
findings.proposedSolution: Fold each wrapper into its target as an explicit call to a named provider: HouseRuleGrantProvider consulted by PrerequisiteChecker/AbilityEngine/FeatStep/TalentStep; CustomTalentTreeProvider consulted by TalentStep tree lookup; Telekinetic correction moved to talent data (after rules review F-PRG-009). Then delete the patch files and add a CI guard rejecting `.prototype.X =` / `Class.method =` assignments on progression/prerequisite classes.
findings.alternatives: Keep patches but document them in progression-architecture.md (does not satisfy A-09).
findings.regressionTests: Existing feat/talent step tests plus new tests constructing TalentStep/FeatStep without registering patches and asserting house-rule grants and custom trees still appear.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Talent and feat picker with house-rule grants and custom talent trees
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes 3 init-order-dependent execution paths; step behavior readable from source
findings.risk: Medium: wrapper ordering effects (e.g. telekinetic wrapping housekeeping) must be preserved

findings.title: ProgressionFinalizer method exists only through a side-effect import in the talents domain
findings.observed: _compileMutationPlanBase calls this._applyForceKnowledgePostApply unconditionally, but the finalizer class does not define it; it is assigned when progression-finalizer-force-knowledge-patch.js is evaluated, which happens only because squad-actions-init.js (Squad Actions macro menu) imports it. choice-resolution-finalization-patch.js similarly wraps _canonicalSkillKey and _extractSkillFocusKeysFromSelections. Tests import the patch explicitly to make the finalizer work.
findings.intendedOwnership: ProgressionFinalizer or ForcePlanBuilder owns Force-knowledge post-apply; SkillsLanguagesPlanBuilder/FeatChoiceResolver owns skill-key canonicalization.
findings.proposedSolution: Move _applyForceKnowledgePostApply/_buildForceKnowledgePostApplyEntry into ForcePlanBuilder (pure) and the choice-resolution fallbacks into _canonicalSkillKey/_extractSkillFocusKeysFromSelections; remove both imports from squad-actions-init.js and delete the patch files.
findings.alternatives: Minimal: import the patch from progression-finalizer.js itself (removes cross-domain coupling but keeps patching).
findings.regressionTests: tests/galactic-profile-mutation-plan.test.mjs and tests/galactic-profile-end-to-end.test.mjs without calling registerProgressionFinalizerForceKnowledgePatch; a test that ProgressionFinalizer has no undefined own-method references.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Finalizer self-contained; removes hidden cross-domain load-order dependency

findings.title: Chargen Summary stages credits and a store flag on the actor before finalization, outside TransactionEngine
findings.observed: enterStore() calls ActorEngine.updateActor with system.credits and flags.swse.chargenStore mid-wizard, then opens the live store against the actor. Finalization later reads the actor balance back through two copies of the same reconciliation (ProgressionFinalizer._resolveFinalStartingCredits and economy builder resolveFinalStartingCredits). The code comment at summary-step.js:1801-1803 states this violates no-actor-mutation-before-confirmation and blocks it only for Galactic Profile sessions. Abandoning chargen leaves the staged credits and any purchases on the actor. Goes through ActorEngine (A-02 satisfied) but not TransactionEngine (A-10) and not through the finalizer (A-15).
findings.intendedOwnership: Starting credits are draft economy state in ProgressionSession; purchases during chargen are a draft cart priced by TransactionEngine and committed atomically with (or immediately after) the finalization plan.
findings.proposedSolution: Owner decision: either (a) chargen store operates on a draft cart in the session and the finalizer emits a TransactionEngine purchase as part of commit, or (b) store opens only after finalization (as Galactic Profile already does). Either way delete _stageStartingCreditsForStore and the duplicated resolveFinalStartingCredits.
findings.alternatives: Keep staging but route through a TransactionEngine "grant starting credits" operation with an abandon-rollback (still mid-wizard mutation).
findings.regressionTests: Test that SummaryStep never calls ActorEngine before finalize; economy builder test for starting credits with and without store purchases.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Chargen: open store, buy, close, change class (budget change), finalize; and abandon after purchase
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes a parallel credit path and two duplicated reconciliation functions

findings.title: Draft persistence via raw setFlag in two parallel stores, including UI step position
findings.observed: Chargen persists the draft twice: SessionStorage (flags foundryvtt-swse.progression.<mode>.session, debounced write-behind, semantic dedupe) and ChargenPersistence (flags foundryvtt-swse.chargen.checkpoint on every forward step exit). Both call actor.setFlag/unsetFlag directly. The snapshot includes currentStepId, so navigation alone causes an actor document update (updateActor hooks, sheet re-render). Completion marker also raw setFlag. Draft data in flags is legitimate durability, but bypasses ActorEngine without an exception comment.
findings.intendedOwnership: One draft store behind ActorEngine flag helper (or a documented Foundry-only exception comment), excluding UI-only position from change detection.
findings.proposedSolution: Merge ChargenPersistence into SessionStorage (it already carries recovery data); write through ActorEngine.updateActorFlags with a guardKey or annotate as documented exception; exclude currentStepId/timestamps from the dedupe key so navigation does not write.
findings.alternatives: Persist drafts in a user flag or client storage keyed by actor id (no actor update hooks at all).
findings.regressionTests: tests/progression-session-persistence-writebehind.test.mjs extended: navigation-only change produces no write; resume works from single store.
findings.risk: Low-medium (existing saved checkpoints need a read fallback)

findings.title: Legacy static ProgressionEngine stack is loaded by unused imports and never invoked
findings.observed: Each of the five importers references ProgressionEngine only on its import line. The closure (ProgressionEngine -> SWSEProgressionEngine instance -> FinalizeIntegration -> ForceProgressionEngine/ApplyHandlers/LevelDiffInspector/feature-dispatcher; TemplateEngine) has no other runtime importer and no pack/macro reference (grep packs). ~2.6k lines evaluated at boot. Contains its own write paths (ActorEngine.updateActor per step, ChatMessage.create in LevelDiffInspector).
findings.intendedOwnership: ProgressionShell + ProgressionFinalizer (A-15).
findings.proposedSolution: Legacy class B -> C: remove the five unused imports, then delete the closure. feature-dispatcher.js is referenced by tests/class-phase-6d-officer-improviser-unlocks.test.mjs and scripts/engine/progression/feats/feat-dispatcher.js (orphan): confirm whether the test exercises live behavior before deleting it.
findings.alternatives: Keep progression-engine.js as an explicit macro facade (class E) if the owner wants a scripting API.
findings.regressionTests: Boot-graph test asserting none of the closure files is reachable from index.js; full suite.
findings.simplificationBenefit: ~2.6k lines and a second finalize path removed

findings.title: 11-file import cycle progression engine <-> mentor dialogues <-> suggestion is closed by one unused import
findings.observed: mentor-dialogues.js imports ProgressionEngine (unused) -> progression.js -> progression-engine-instance.js -> SuggestionService -> SuggestionEngineCoordinator -> SuggestionEngine -> SuggestionScorer -> mentor-dialogues.js (getMentorForClass). Removing mentor-dialogues.js:1 breaks this SCC; SuggestionService<->Coordinator and SuggestionEngine<->Coordinator mutual imports remain inside mentor-suggestion.
findings.intendedOwnership: Mentor/suggestion are advisory providers below progression orchestration (A-P1).
findings.proposedSolution: Delete the unused import at mentor-dialogues.js:1 (and F-PRG-005).
findings.regressionTests: P-A07-static-cycles probe count drops by one SCC; mentor tests.

findings.title: ProgressionFinalizer computes each wired domain inline and then replaces it with builder output
findings.observed: Documented in progression-architecture.md (base compilation remains and is clobbered). Census clones: finalizer vs economy builder collectSelectionEntries, finalizer vs skills-languages builder skill key canonicalization; duplicated chargen-store credit reconciliation. Module is 4,057 lines mixing orchestration, inline class compilation, post-apply sync, ability-increase guard, certification.
findings.intendedOwnership: Builders are the single implementation per domain; finalizer only orchestrates (C-PRG-2).
findings.proposedSolution: Per domain, delete the inline base branch once a plan-equivalence test (inline vs builder) exists; extract FinalizationCertification and PostApplySync seams. Not a file-count merge.
findings.alternatives: Leave as-is until a Foundry harness exists (status quo documented).
findings.regressionTests: Golden mutation-plan snapshots per domain before/after removal.

findings.title: Three independent BAB calculations in progression with divergent behavior on sparse class tables
findings.observed: levelup-shared.calculateTotalBAB matches lp.level === classLevel exactly; class-suggestion-utilities.calculateTotalBAB uses the highest row <= classLevel and accepts more field spellings; progression-data.calculateBAB indexes level_progression[level-1] from class-data-loader. The Summary step preview uses the old-app helper. actor-prerequisite-snapshot calculateBab reads prepared actor values (consumer, not duplicate).
findings.intendedOwnership: actor-core derived calculator (A-03) or a single class-table BAB function in classes domain.
findings.proposedSolution: Choose one class-table BAB function (classes domain), make the other two delegate, and have previews read it.
findings.regressionTests: Table test over all class records comparing the three outputs (should be identical for complete tables).

findings.title: Telekinetic Savant/Prodigy text and slot rule hard-coded in a runtime patch, diverging from canonical reference text
findings.observed: The patch replaces picker description/benefit/prerequisite text for two talents with in-code strings and filters the ForcePowerStep Prodigy resolution (suppressProdigyOnlyRetroactiveSlot). The in-code Prodigy text says the extra power must have the [Telekinetic] descriptor and adds a Wisdom-increase clause; the canonical reference (FUCG p.88) says it must be one of the powers affected by Telekinetic Savant. Which text/behavior is authoritative is a rules question; the audit does not decide it.
findings.intendedOwnership: Talent text in talent data (talents domain); Prodigy entitlement in FeatGrantEntitlementResolver / force-suite-resolution.
findings.proposedSolution: Record a register entry (DEFERRED_RULES_REVIEW) with both texts; after a ruling, move text into data and the slot rule into the entitlement resolver; delete the patch.
findings.regressionTests: Force Training with/without Move Object, with Prodigy, at chargen and on later WIS increase.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Force power step with Telekinetic Prodigy

findings.title: Finalization is one transactional plan plus non-atomic post-commit writes
findings.observed: After applyMutationPlan, maneuver suite sync, ability-increase verification marker and certification are separate ActorEngine.updateActor calls; failures are surfaced (postApplyIncomplete / committed-unverified), not rolled back. All go through ActorEngine. This is a deliberate, documented design (comments at progression-finalizer.js:3970-3975) but contradicts the "commits once" wording.
findings.intendedOwnership: ActorEngine
findings.proposedSolution: Amend A-15/progression-architecture wording to "one transactional plan + idempotent post-commit evidence writes"; optionally fold maneuver sync into the plan.

findings.title: Finalizer resolves ActorEngine through a global fallback chain
findings.observed: _resolveActorEngine prefers globalThis.SWSE.ActorEngine / game.swse.ActorEngine / globalThis.ActorEngine before the imported canonical module, falling back to engines exposing applyProgression or updateActor ("older global facade").
findings.intendedOwnership: Imported canonical ActorEngine
findings.proposedSolution: Use the imported CanonicalActorEngine; allow a test seam only via explicit injection.
findings.regressionTests: Finalizer tests inject an engine explicitly

findings.title: AttributeIncreaseHandler.clearPendingGains mixes ActorEngine and raw unsetFlag

findings.proposedSolution: Use the ActorEngine flag helper for both branches.
findings.regressionTests: unit test of clearPendingGains with a stub engine

findings.title: Probe false positives and legitimate caches
findings.observed: P-A02/A-04 hits in progression-shell, force-power-step and the enforcer guard are Map/Set.delete. talent-step caches are reset on every onStepEnter and keyed by Block/Deflect mode (invalidation present; probe flag "no invalidate" is a false positive).
findings.proposedSolution: Refine probes to ignore Map/Set .delete and constructor resets.

findings.title: Unreachable module clusters (75 census-unreachable modules, ~12k SLOC)
findings.observed: Repository-wide grep (scripts, index.js, templates, packs, system.json) per module: ux/* (explainability, recovery, diagnostics, summary-step-enhancement: importers only among themselves) - dead C; content/* (bridge-to-store, faction-kit-bridge, packaged-build-registry, target-path-definitions, campaign-preset-bridge, template-personalization-engine, content-growth-validator, domain-support-closure, advisory-domain-profiles) - no importers, unwired-but-intended features (UNIMPLEMENTED) or dead; forecast/* - unwired; talents slot-*/TalentTree*/tree-unlock-manager, feats feat-slot-migrator/feat-dispatcher/*-registry-ui, engine/tools/*, validators/*, autocalc, autogrants - dead C; confirm-step.js test-only ("ConfirmStep merged into Summary", chargen-shell.js:462) - dead C; follower-details/feat/human-bonus steps and name-step orphan - dead C; scripts/apps/progression-framework/registries/progression-node-registry.js - re-export shim D; CharacterGenerationEngine.js mentioned only in comments/validator - C. FALSE POSITIVE: progression-rail-resizer.js is live via inline dynamic import() in progression-shell.hbs.
findings.proposedSolution: Delete C clusters in one PR per directory after a boot-graph check; owner triage of content/ and forecast/ (wire vs delete); mark rail-resizer reachable in the census (template dynamic import).
findings.alternatives: Move experiments to an archive branch

findings.title: Hard-coded fallback starting credits by class
findings.observed: When neither content authority nor class/background records yield credits, a fixed table (soldier/scout/scoundrel 3000, jedi/force_adept 1200, noble 4800) is used - a default for missing published data (CLAUDE.md §3).
findings.intendedOwnership: Class data (classes domain)
findings.proposedSolution: DEFERRED_RULES_REVIEW entry; prefer failing visibly when class data lacks starting credits.

findings.title: SWSELanguageModule hooks are dormant (init never called)
findings.observed: init() registers a chargen/level-up language writer and an updateActor listener but has no caller; only static helpers are used by AttributeIncreaseHandler. If ever initialized it would be a second languages writer competing with SkillsLanguagesPlanBuilder.
findings.intendedOwnership: SkillsLanguagesPlanBuilder
findings.proposedSolution: Delete init() and listeners; keep helpers or move them to the language engine.

findings.title: Engine-layer progression modules import progression UI (15 edges)
findings.observed: Patch files (F-PRG-001) account for 5 edges; the rest are services importing shell/session or reconciler helpers that live under apps/.
findings.intendedOwnership: Pure helpers live under engine/; apps import engine
findings.proposedSolution: After F-PRG-001, move the shared pure helpers (session shape, reconciler invalidation, step normalizers) to engine/progression.

findings.title: progression-architecture.md is stale on patching and squad-actions-init
findings.observed: See CR-PRG-01..03. Other candidates linked as historical evidence: docs/audits/progression-runtime-integrity-audit.md, docs/audits/reconciliation-v2-progression-authority-audit.md, docs/systems/PROGRESSION_COMPILER_UNIFICATION.md, docs/systems/V2-PROGRESSION-UI.md.

findings.title: Retired chargen/level-up app directories still host live helpers
findings.observed: No old chargen/level-up application remains; the directories hold helpers (hit die, BAB, defense bonuses, random names, ChargenDataCache) and SWSENpcLevelUpEntry (a chooser launched from progression-entry and the NPC sheet). Legacy class B (referenced).
